safeguards: The not-to-scale label stays exact English and the until-distances-checked condition is preserved in all three target body 1 fields.

The north marker and house/trees/water/roads/fences object order are retained. VE and TS keep fences exact English because mitsheto was not established as the intended physical fence term; VE keeps land exact English where muvuni could narrow the source.
Canonical English and learner registries are untouched. Each changed target remains status draft under unreviewed packet metadata.
Only the exact three Sesotho orthography fields were changed; no global substitutions were applied.
sourceVariation: The canonical body and paired narration differ only in the list punctuation/conjunction: canonical says “roads, fences”; paired English says “roads, and fences”. Both list the same five objects in the same order. Canonical quotes “not to scale”; paired narration omits those quote marks.
